01 — The space in between

Still capable.
Just knocked
off track.

An injury. A failed exam. A career break. Burnout. The setback is one thing. Being left to make sense of it alone is another.

One system asks you to keep climbing. Another steps in when everything breaks down. Neither is built for the person in between.

We’re building the missing part: structured support for the return itself. A plan to practise. People who check in. A next step you can actually take.

PerformanceKeep climbing.
COStrongFind your way back.
CrisisPick up the pieces.

04 — Heal · Corporate lab

“Fine” isn’t
the same as
doing well.

Because burnout is not a badge of honour. The office is the new high-pressure playing field — and teams need somewhere to practise being human in it.

S/heStays Corporate is a 2–3 day offsite residential lab. A structured space to practise what classroom trainings never touch.

Enquire for your team ↗
  • 01Stage & presentation confidence under pressure
  • 02Peer interaction & psychological safety
  • 03Burnout recovery & routine rebuilding
  • 04Individual Resilience Plans carried back to work

Presentation paralysis. Feedback avoidance. Stage phobia. Burnout wearing the costume of busyness.

These aren’t personality flaws — they are trainable.

There is no single kind of comeback.

Sometimes, strength is simply
showing up again.

08 — Stories of return

The part you don’t see on a podium.

“
Not motivation.
Drills.

Her coach kept saying “just play freely,” but nobody explained how you walk onto court without flinching after two bad tournaments. The Individual Resilience Plan broke it into actual reps — not motivation, drills. That’s what stuck.

Aditi R.S/heStays Sport · U16 Batch
“
Day three, he made
a timetable.

He had booked and cancelled therapy four times before Neemrana. Three fixed days with a group made it easier to actually show up. Day two he cried in the middle of a practice session. Day three he made a timetable he’s still using five weeks later.

Samar K.Practice Homestay · Cohort 4
“

He expected trust falls. Instead, twelve people admitted out loud they’d been faking “fine” in stand-ups for months. Three are now in therapy because of that one conversation.

Nikhil M.S/heStays Corporate · HR Lead
“
Her comeback.
Not just her injury.

Six months off after knee surgery, and every “get well soon” message made it worse — like the return itself was invisible to everyone but her. The check-ins were the first time someone tracked her comeback, not just her injury.

09 — Where it began

“Building what
I once needed —
a place to return.”

Before there was a lab, there was a career interruption. Ikanshi Khanna built Practice Homestay and S/heStays out of her own experience of finding a way back.

Working at the intersection of youth development, gender and emotional wellbeing, she is building the structure she once needed: somewhere to practise, people to return with, and support that stays beyond the first step.

Ikanshi KhannaFounder · COStrong & Nawabi Nuts
